newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Sa Sa Int'l debuts at HK$2.80 per share.
newsitem.headline: Sa Sa Int'l debuts at HK$2.80 per share.

text.p: Shares of cosmetics retailer Sa Sa International Holdings Ltd made their trading debut at HK$2.80 per share on Friday, compared with their issue price of HK$2.38 each.

Sa Sa offered a total 328 million new shares in global offering. Its Hong Kong public offering portion of 59.04 million shares was about 531 times subscribed and another 6.56 million shares reserved for employees were fully allotted.

The company engages in the retail and wholesale of a wide range of cosmetic products including skin-care, make-up, fragrances and hair care products. It operates a chain of 11 retail outlets in Hong Kong and one in Taipei, Taiwan.
Sa Sa had said most of the proceeds raised from the new issue would be used to expand its operation network in Asia.
